    m = re.search(r"(\d{1,2})\s+([A-Za-z]+)(?:\s+(\d{4}))?", cleaned)
    if not m:
        return None
    day = int(m.group(1))
    month_text = m.group(2)[:3].title()
    year = int(m.group(3)) if m.group(3) else 2021
    month = datetime.strptime(month_text, "%b").month
    return datetime(year, month, day)

    if sentence is None or str(sentence).strip() == "":

    due_match = re.search(r"Due", s, flags=re.IGNORECASE)

        return None, None, None

    name_part = s[:added_match.start()]

    added_part = s[added_match.end():due_match.start()]
    if added_part and added_part[0] in (" ", "\xa0"):
        added_part = added_part[1:]

    due_part = s[due_match.end():]
    due_part_clean = due_part.replace("\xa0", " ").strip()

for row in range(min_row, max_row + 1):

    ws.cell(row=row, column=min_col + 2).value = due_date_value
    if due_date_value is not None:
